references.text: The same chapter describes the procedure when someone has a skin disease and must be brought to the priest for examination.
Describes the law concerning the leper on his day of cleansing, when he is to be brought to the priest.
Commands that all with leprosy be sent outside the camp, showing the priest's role in handling such cases.
Moses urges Israel to be careful to follow the priests' guidance regarding leprosy.
The story of Naaman, who had leprosy and was healed, illustrates the seriousness of the disease and God's healing power.
Jesus heals a leper and sends him to the priest to show himself, in accordance with the law of Moses.
Jesus heals ten lepers and commands them to show themselves to the priests, as fulfillment of the law.
